command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
# #997 MIGRATION — MIG-18c. Repair the two AUTOMATED checks this migration broke.
#
# MIG-17 (closing the gap report 001's review assigned to this lane) found four scripts that assume
# Ollama is a container. Two of them run on a schedule and now lie:
#
#   lab-health.ps1                 `docker ps --filter name=ollama` -> "Ollama : DOWN [FAIL]" forever,
#                                  which also writes alerts.log and flips OVERALL to fail
#   hermes-placement-readiness.ps1 $ollamaUp = ($running -contains "ollama") -> local_llm_capability
#                                  _health = FAIL_CLOSED / OLLAMA_DOWN, directly contradicting the
#                                  service this lane just commissioned and proved
#
# Both are repaired to ask the canonical endpoint instead of Docker. That is the same instruction the
# packet gave for start-hermes.ps1 -- reconcile the documented paths with the new topology -- applied
# to the paths that run without anyone watching. The two remaining scripts (core-online.ps1,
# model-pull.ps1) are operator-invoked, fail loudly rather than silently, and are TYPED not rewritten.
#
# Each replacement is an exact-line match verified before it is applied; a mismatch aborts that file
# rather than writing a regex's best guess into a health monitor.

$bakDir = 'C:\HermesLab\hermes\_997-rollback'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $bakDir | Out-Null
$stamp = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ')
$changed = @()

function Repair-Line {
    param([string]$Path, [int]$LineNo, [string]$Expect, [string[]]$Replacement)
    $name = Split-Path $Path -Leaf
    $lines = [System.Collections.ArrayList]@(Get-Content $Path)
    $idx = $LineNo - 1
    if ($lines[$idx].Trim() -ne $Expect.Trim()) {
        Write-Output "  ABORT $name L$LineNo -- expected:"
        Write-Output "     [$Expect]"
        Write-Output "  found:"
        Write-Output "     [$($lines[$idx])]"
        return $false
    }
    $lines.RemoveAt($idx)
    for ($k = $Replacement.Count - 1; $k -ge 0; $k--) { $lines.Insert($idx, $Replacement[$k]) }
    Set-Content -Path $Path -Value $lines -Encoding UTF8
    Write-Output "  OK $name L$LineNo replaced with $($Replacement.Count) line(s)"
    return $true
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- lab-health.ps1
$lh = 'C:\HermesLab\hermes\lab-health.ps1'
Write-Output "--- lab-health.ps1 ---"
Write-Output "before_sha256=$((Get-FileHash $lh -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower())"
Copy-Item $lh "$bakDir\lab-health.ps1.bak-997-$stamp"
$lhLines = Get-Content $lh
$target = ($lhLines | Select-String -Pattern 'docker ps --filter name=ollama' | Select-Object -First 1)
if ($target) {
    Write-Output "  found at L$($target.LineNumber)"
    $ok = Repair-Line -Path $lh -LineNo $target.LineNumber -Expect $target.Line -Replacement @(
        '# Ollama is a Windows service now (#997), not a container -- ask the API, not Docker.',
        '$ollamaOk=$false; try{ $null=Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version -TimeoutSec 6; $ollamaOk=$true }catch{}',
        'if($ollamaOk){ "  Ollama  : running (native 127.0.0.1:11434)   [OK]" } else { "  Ollama  : DOWN   [FAIL]"; Bump "fail"; P "fail" "Ollama down" }'
    )
    if ($ok) { $changed += 'lab-health.ps1' }
} else { Write-Output '  ABORT: the ollama container check was not found' }
Write-Output "after_sha256=$((Get-FileHash $lh -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower())"

# ------------------------------------------------- hermes-placement-readiness.ps1
$pr = 'C:\HermesLab\hermes\hermes-placement-readiness.ps1'
Write-Output "--- hermes-placement-readiness.ps1 ---"
Write-Output "before_sha256=$((Get-FileHash $pr -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower())"
Copy-Item $pr "$bakDir\hermes-placement-readiness.ps1.bak-997-$stamp"

$okA = Repair-Line -Path $pr -LineNo 40 -Expect '$ollamaUp = ($running -contains "ollama")' -Replacement @(
    '# Ollama is a Windows service now (#997), not a container in $running.',
    '$ollamaUp = $false; try{ $null=Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version -TimeoutSec 8; $ollamaUp=$true }catch{}'
)
# Line 43 shifted by one because the replacement above added a line.
$okB = Repair-Line -Path $pr -LineNo 44 -Expect '$ol = docker exec ollama ollama list 2>$null' -Replacement @(
    '  # Same NAME / ID / SIZE / MODIFIED shape the parser below already expects, from /api/tags.',
    '  $ol = @()',
    '  try {',
    '    foreach($m in (Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags -TimeoutSec 15).models){',
    '      $ol += ("{0} {1} {2} GB {3}" -f $m.name, $m.digest.Substring(0,12), [math]::Round($m.size/1GB,1), $m.modified_at)',
    '    }',
    '  } catch {}'
)
if ($okA -and $okB) { $changed += 'hermes-placement-readiness.ps1' }
Write-Output "after_sha256=$((Get-FileHash $pr -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower())"
Write-Output "changed=$($changed -join ',')"
Write-Output "ROLLBACK_PROCEDURE=Copy-Item '$bakDir\lab-health.ps1.bak-997-$stamp' '$lh' -Force ; Copy-Item '$bakDir\hermes-placement-readiness.ps1.bak-997-$stamp' '$pr' -Force"

Write-Output ''
Write-Output '--- VERIFY: placement readiness (runs locally, no ssh) ---'
& powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $pr 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 4
Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
$pj = Get-Content 'C:\HermesLab\hermes\hermes-placement.json' -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ConvertFrom-Json
Write-Output "local_llm_capability_health=$($pj.local_llm_capability_health) reason=$($pj.local_llm_reason)"
Write-Output "ollama=$($pj.resources.ollama)  models_inventoried=$($pj.model_inventory.Count)"
$pj.model_inventory | ForEach-Object { "   model=$($_.name) size_gb=$($_.size_gb) fits_gpu=$($_.fits_gpu) path=$($_.preferred_path)" }

Write-Output ''
Write-Output '--- VERIFY: lab health via its OWN scheduled task ---'
# NOT run inline: lab-health.ps1 ssh'es to ATLAS and AEGIS, and a nested ssh from inside this session
# tears the outer session down. The task is the execution path it actually runs under anyway.
Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'HermesLabHealth'
$deadline = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(3)
while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline -and (Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'HermesLabHealth').State -eq 'Running') { Start-Sleep -Seconds 5 }
Write-Output "task_state=$((Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'HermesLabHealth').State) last_result=$((Get-ScheduledTaskInfo -TaskName 'HermesLabHealth').LastTaskResult)"
Write-Output "lab-health.json: $(Get-Content 'C:\HermesLab\hermes\lab-health.json' -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)"
Write-Output '--- RC ---'
